content.title: Retail stocks slide, Tilray Brands earnings, Mattel downgrade
content.description:
Market Domination Host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma take a closer look at some of the trending tickers during Friday's session.

Retail stocks, like Under Armour (UAA, UA), Kohl's (KSS), and Lululemon (LULU), fell after the US Supreme Court didn't release a final ruling on President Trump's tariff policies that was expected on Friday.

Tilray Brands (TLRY) stock is in focus following the cannabis company's second quarter earnings results.

Goldman downgrades its rating on Mattel stock (MAT) to Neutral.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Consumer sentiment rises to 4-month high, retail stocks drop
content.description:
Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including retail stocks' reactions to the Supreme Court delaying their decision on President Trump's tariff policies, US consumer sentiment rising to its highest level since September 2025, and TD Cowen analysts forecast Chevron (CVX) could see a $700 million per year boost from Venezuelan oil production (CL=F, BZ=F).

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: Retail Stocks Fall on Supreme Court Tariff Disappointment
content.summary: Retail stocks were tumbling on Friday, reflecting investors' disappointment over the fact that the Supreme Court did not issue an opinion on the Trump administration’s tariff policies.  Of course, the court will release its opinion at some point, likely by the end of January.

content.title: What The Shifting Turnaround Story Means For Kohl’s (KSS) Valuation
content.summary: The latest valuation update for Kohl's edges its fair value estimate to about US$22.17 from about US$21.82, a small shift that mirrors how divided but engaged current research views have become. Street analysts are lifting price targets across the board, yet ratings still span Buy, Hold and Sell as they weigh recent Q3 execution against questions about how durable any turnaround could be. As this push and pull continues to shape the story around Kohl's, it is worth staying tuned to see how...

content.title: Bloomingdale's Momentum Strengthens Macy's Luxury-Led Growth Profile
content.summary: Bloomingdale's drove M's luxury-led growth in Q3, posting 8.6% comps, a fifth straight gain and reinforcing its role as an earnings stabilizer.

content.title: Is Dillard's Digital Growth Enough to Offset Store Traffic Slump?
content.summary: DDS leans on its digital platform as mall traffic stays uneven, delivering 3% y/y retail sales growth in Q3, while balancing omnichannel and store investments.

content.title: The biggest retail challenges anticipated in 2026
content.description:
Forrester Research Retail Analyst Sucharita Kodali sits down with Yahoo Finance markets and data editor Jared Blikre on Market Catalysts to discuss the headwinds that major retailers are expecting for 2026, including weather patterns and the interest rate environment.

Also catch Sucharita Kodali look back on 2025's consumer spending trends.
